column3: Close to the Hebrew; “numerous” is rendered “very strong.”
Close to the Hebrew; the past “has brought” is rendered “will bring.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to wage war on” is rendered “To fight for.”
Close to the Hebrew; “pass over” (pasach) is rendered “Passing over… He will preserve it.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV makes “sin” an appositive, “sin, which your own hands have made.”
Close to the Hebrew; “his rock will pass away” is rendered “He shall cross over to his stronghold,” and “oven” “furnace.”
